about: E100R2-PF-4m (POST-HOC run, not in the pre-registered table): idealized supercell in the 24 May 2011 El Reno environment, post latent-heating fix, 4 m moving nest spawned at 2160 s from a 100 m parent, vortex-following 227x227x45 window every 0.09375 s. The window stream has no receipt (leg L0 ended with rc=2 at 3452.8 s) and is split over two arenas (L0's stream up to 3300.0 s and L0's kept tail 3300.09375-3452.4375 s), so it is read through tools/criterion_v2/window_segments.py; the child frames are read by score.py directly. Clean records end at 3452.4375 s (records 13786-13789 were the CFL runaway and are deleted). Never S3/frames-L1 (leg L1, stopped).

window_segments.reference_note: check (a) of the nest-dt audit: the unchanged S3 deck and frozen tree resumed from restart 12 (3300 s); its receipt is a real schema-v3 receipt of this geometry, and its 32 records (3300.09375-3303.0 s) are byte-identical to L0's tail (STATUS.md 2026-09-24).
window_segments.nest_start_source: S3/deck.toml [run] rstnum = 8 (P-chain restart 8, t = 2160 s); S3/run.log 'resumed 5760 completed large steps (t=2160.0s)'
